user.title: Vacuum water level
user.description: Sets the default low-water warning thresholds. After setup, add each vacuum from the integration's Configure menu.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of this integration is allowed.

add_vacuum.title: Add a vacuum
add_vacuum.description: Pick a vacuum entity to start tracking water usage for.

edit_vacuum_menu.title: What do you want to change?

menu_options.edit_mop_entities: Set the mop mode / intensity entities

edit_dock_error.title: Dock error sensor
edit_dock_error.description: Assign the entity that reports the dock's errors for {entity_id}. If the error is reported as a state attribute rather than the entity's main state (e.g. a docking-station entity whose state is 'docked' but whose 'error' attribute reads 'Water empty'), also give the attribute name. The three trigger messages below are matched however they're capitalized/formatted, and can be customized to match your vacuum's exact wording. Leave the entity blank to clear this and fall back to auto-detection.

data.dock_error_attribute: Attribute name (optional — leave blank to use the entity's state)
data.waste_total_ml: Waste/dirty tank capacity (defaults to the same as the clean tank)

edit_mop_entities.title: Mop mode / intensity entities
edit_mop_entities.description: Assign the entities that report mop mode and mop intensity for {entity_id}, overriding auto-detection. The intensity entity's state (e.g. Off/Low/Medium/High) is used both for water usage calculations and to train the adaptive prediction model per intensity level — pick the right one if auto-detection found the wrong entity or nothing at all. Leave either field blank to fall back to auto-detection for that entity.

select_brand.title: Brand
select_brand.description: Pick the brand for {entity_id}. If a confident guess was possible it's pre-selected — otherwise pick 'Other / not listed' to enter capacity manually.

select_model.title: Model
select_model.description: Pick the {brand} model, or 'Other / custom capacity' to enter capacity manually.

custom_capacity.title: Tank capacity
custom_capacity.description: Enter the mop water tank capacity in mL for this vacuum.

remove_vacuum.title: Stop tracking a vacuum
remove_vacuum.description: This removes the vacuum's water-tracking entities and discards its tank history.
